rule_problems: 1. Confidence and a guide used as the second site. Rules: vocabularies.md High or Medium tie-break ('When established sites, or pages of one site, contradict each other on a point the entry uses and no official text settles it … Drop to medium only when a contradicted point decides a term the entry codes, such as … a band'); fields.md sources[] ('Confidence counts only the cited pages … When another established site covers the unit, cite it rather than a third page of the same site'); games-r1.md ('CNCNZ is that other site … though its kind stays guide'). Result: one slip on CNCNZ (the snipe's cooldown given as instant) drops an entry that has cited official text, and whose wiki and game data agree, to medium. The level also depends only on whether the coder cites the guide: A cited it and got medium, B did not and got high. I kept medium and added an uncertain entry at confidence. Proposed fix: let the unedited game files the registry names (kind database) settle a contradicted figure as official text does. Or let a guide-kind page's contradiction lower confidence only when no official or game-data page settles the point. Also state that the tie-break reads the same page set as confidence.

2. A general's version with extra buttons. Rule: games-r3.md research notes ('a general's version that differs … goes in the notes of the fields it would change, never in on_death outcomes or traits'). abilities[] has no notes field, so the Demolition General's timed charge, remote charge and detonator ended up in tier.basis (A) or on_death.notes (B), neither of which concerns them. I kept tier.basis plus an uncertain entry at abilities. Proposed fix: name tier.basis, which already lists the generals' versions, as the place for a version's extra or missing buttons, or add an optional abilities[].notes field.

3. Infiltrator from an official label. Rules: roles.secondary step 1 ('Official text calls the unit by the role label or one of its aliases'), but the roles tie-breaks say 'Infiltrator needs spying, theft or sabotage from inside' and 'Infiltrator is for spying, theft and sabotage from inside, or for passing as the enemy'. The manual's 'Base Infiltration' keeps infiltrator, yet the main version never gets inside enemy units or buildings: he empties a vehicle from range and another soldier takes it. Both coders kept it; I kept it with an uncertain entry at roles/secondary. Proposed fix: say whether a role that official text names at secondary step 1 must still pass that role's tie-break. If it must, Kell's second slot would go to anti-armour from the Sniper Attack button (step 2, recorded in atypical).

4. hijack-vehicle covers only half of the snipe. Rules: fields.md Pattern links ('Link a pattern when the ability … gives the player the same interaction and the enemy the same counterplay as the pattern's summary … When research/registry-notes/patterns.md disagrees with a pattern's summary, the summary wins'). patterns.md maps 'Snipe a vehicle's crew' to hijack-vehicle, but that summary ('Take over an enemy vehicle by throwing out or killing its crew') has the attacker take the vehicle. Kell never does: the hull goes neutral for either side to claim. Both coders linked it; I kept the link with A's fit_note and B's uncertain entry. Proposed fix: when hijack-vehicle is written, add a ranged crew-kill variant that empties the vehicle so that either side can claim it, or widen the summary to 'take over, or empty for capture'. Also say in Pattern links that a summary covering half the interaction gets the link plus a fit_note.

5. can_target lists structure because of one building type. Rules: armament[].can_target ('Every kind of target the weapon can be fired at and hurt in the source, even a little' … 'for a family that leaves them out, list them only when the sources say the weapon damages buildings'). The Fire Base alone (with its occupants) makes an anti-infantry rifle list structure and puts the sniper family in atypical, which a generator could read as a sniper that attacks buildings. Both coders listed it; I kept [infantry, structure] and added to the can_target uncertain entry that structure rests on that one building and the rifle in practice works only against soldiers. Proposed fix: list a kind only when the weapon can hurt that kind in general, and name a lone exception such as one building type in the summary instead.
